reproduction_target: Computational de novo genome assembly + annotation pipeline for naked mole-rat (H. glaber): PacBio CLR assembly (Canu) + Illumina polishing (Pilon) + haplotig purging (Purge_dups), repeat masking (RepeatModeler/RepeatMasker/EDTA), gene prediction (BRAKER3) with public RNA-Seq evidence, functional annotation (Fanflow/GGSEARCH/HMMER-Pfam), and comparative/SV analyses vs Ensembl NMR assembly (Minimap2, Svim-asm, Sniffles, Liftoff, Minigraph-Cactus).
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from Methods prose of the published Scientific Data version (PMC13149982; biorxiv full text was Cloudflare-blocked, published JATS used as equivalent methods source). Code availability explicitly states 'No custom scripts were used' — no author pipeline repo exists; only third-party tool repos (sra-tools, dotPlotly) are cited as tool sources, not read. Wet-lab sequencing steps counted in W, not verdicted (layer W / OOS for computational reproduction).

steps.label: GenomeScope2 genome-size/heterozygosity/repeat estimation (k=32) from Illumina reads
Canu 2.1 de novo assembly of PacBio CLR reads (-genomesize 3.0g -coverage 200 -minlength 1000 -raw -pacbio)
Pilon polishing (3 rounds, default settings, Illumina short reads) — no version
Purge_dups haplotig purging (default parameters) — no version
Merqury v1.3 assembly validation (k=21)
BUSCO v5.2.2 completeness (-l glires_odb10 / OrthoDB v10 Glires)
RepeatModeler v2.0.3 de novo repeat library modeling
RepeatMasker v4.0.6 soft-masking of repetitive sequences
Extensive de novo TE Annotator (EDTA) v2.0.1 TE annotation wrapper
SRA toolkit v3.0.5 retrieval + FASTQ conversion of public RNA-Seq (accession list not enumerated; 'manually filtered')
Trim Galore! v0.6.10 trimming/QC of RNA-Seq FASTQ (--fastqc --trim1)
HISAT2 v2.2.1 RNA-Seq alignment to genome (-q --dta)
SAMtools v1.12 SAM-to-BAM conversion of RNA-Seq alignments
BRAKER3 gene prediction (RNA-Seq BAMs + Vertebrate protein DB partitioned_odb11 as extrinsic evidence) — no version
Fanflow functional-annotation workflow (reference protein comparison) — no version, no repo pinned in prose
GGSEARCH v36.3.8g (FASTA package) amino-acid homology vs human/mouse/guinea-pig/NMR/UniProtKB-SwissProt
HMMSCAN (HMMER v3.3.2) domain search against Pfam v35.0
miniprot protein-to-genome mapping onto Ensembl female NMR genome — no version
bedtools intersect v2.31.1 overlap of mapped proteins with Ensembl GFF3 (-s -loj)
MAFFT amino-acid alignment (--auto) — no version
Minimap2 v2.28 genome-genome alignment for dot plots and SV mapping (-cx asm5 ; asm5 --cs -r2k)
dotPlotly dot-plot visualization (-s -t -m 500 -q 500000 -l) — no version
Svim-asm v1.0.3 assembly-based SV calling (default options, >40 bp)
Minigraph-Cactus intraspecific variation graph (SNPs+SVs) — no version
Sniffles read-based SV calling from PacBio raw reads — no version
Liftoff v1.5.2 annotation transfer to Ensembl female NMR assembly (valid_ORF=True, match_ref_proteins=FALSE, Sequence_ID filtering)
Intervene gene-set intersection analysis — no version
Metascape enrichment analysis (web tool, default settings) — no version, closed web service

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 16/28 computational steps (all version-pinned tools: Canu 2.1, Merqury 1.3, BUSCO 5.2.2, RepeatModeler 2.0.3, RepeatMasker 4.0.6, EDTA 2.0.1, SRA-toolkit 3.0.5, TrimGalore 0.6.10, HISAT2 2.2.1, SAMtools 1.12, GGSEARCH 36.3.8g, HMMER 3.3.2, bedtools 2.31.1, Minimap2 2.28, Svim-asm 1.0.3, Liftoff 1.5.2). 12/28 steps cap at NI due to unpinned tool versions (GenomeScope2, Pilon, Purge_dups, BRAKER3, Fanflow, miniprot, MAFFT, dotPlotly, Minigraph-Cactus, Sniffles, Intervene, Metascape). R★ not assignable at stage1. No env lockfile or container claimed and 'No custom scripts were used', so exact pins are partial (no closure); even under stage2 no step exceeds RI without an executed environment capture — none is claimed to exist.
headline.coverage: 28 computational steps assessed from published-version Methods prose (PMC13149982, equivalent to biorxiv preprint methods). 6 wet-lab library-prep/sequencing steps counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope.

gaps.missing: No environment lockfile, no container, no conda/env spec. Code availability explicitly: 'All programs and pipelines were executed following their official manuals... Version and parameter information... provided in the Methods section. No custom scripts were used.' ~16 tools carry exact version pins in prose (partial capture, no closure); 12 tools carry no version at all.
gaps.how_to_close: Provide a lockfile (conda-lock/pixi) or container digest per platform pinning every tool + its dependencies, and version-pin the 12 currently-floating tools (GenomeScope2, Pilon, Purge_dups, BRAKER3, Fanflow, miniprot, MAFFT, dotPlotly, Minigraph-Cactus, Sniffles, Intervene, Metascape).

gaps.where: 12 unpinned tools across assembly, annotation, and comparative SV steps
gaps.missing: Version numbers absent for GenomeScope2, Pilon, Purge_dups, BRAKER3, Fanflow, miniprot, MAFFT, dotPlotly, Minigraph-Cactus, Sniffles, Intervene, Metascape — these steps cannot reach RI.
gaps.how_to_close: Record exact version (and build) for each of these tools in Methods or a versions table.

gaps.where: BRAKER3 extrinsic RNA-Seq evidence (public SRA runs)
gaps.missing: Public RNA-Seq input was collected via SRA Run Selector and 'manually filtered to retain only samples with well-defined metadata' — the exact list of SRA/DRR run accessions used as evidence is not enumerated in the prose.
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the explicit list of SRA run accessions used as BRAKER3 evidence (e.g., as a supplementary sample sheet).

gaps.where: C28 Metascape enrichment (and Ensembl BioMart mapping)
gaps.missing: Metascape is a closed hosted web service with no version/snapshot recorded (default settings, accessed 2024-10-25); underlying annotation DBs update over time, so results are not deterministically reproducible.
gaps.how_to_close: Record Metascape release/date-stamped export and the underlying gene-set database versions, or substitute a scriptable open enrichment tool with pinned DB.

gaps.where: Wet-lab: NMR husbandry, genomic DNA extraction (QIAGEN Genomic-tip), DNA QC (Qubit/Pippin Pulse), shearing (g-tube/Covaris M220), PacBio SMRTbell library prep + Sequel II sequencing, Illumina TruSeq PCR-Free library + NovaSeq 6000 sequencing
gaps.missing: Physical sequence-generation steps are out of scope for computational reproduction (OOS); counted in W (6), not verdicted. Raw reads are deposited (DDBJ DRR401650–DRR401653).
gaps.how_to_close: N/A for Tier-1 computational readiness; the deposited raw reads are the reproducible entry point to the pipeline.
